title: No schema version tracking: future migrations have no guard against double-apply or incompatible databases
description: Scenario: in a future release, the blocks table needs a new column. Without a schema_version table or a user_version PRAGMA, there is no clean way to detect whether a database is at v1 or has already been migrated. The only safe migration path is to check if the column exists (PRAGMA table_info) before ALTER TABLE — which works but has to be reimplemented each time. The maintenance consequence: every future migration requires writing bespoke detection logic rather than a version-gated upgrade path. The fix is a one-liner at open() time: PRAGMA user_version returns 0 for a new DB; set it to 1 on first open so future migrations can branch on the integer.
